records.title: Stabilizing Recurrent Dynamics for Test-Time Scalable Latent Reasoning in Looped Language Models
records.reason: STARS stabilizes recurrent latent reasoning so performance remains reliable at greater test-time depth, but it does not show inference compute/memory savings; the method may enable more scaling rather than reduce cost.

records.title: VideoSeek: Long-Horizon Video Agent with Tool-Guided Seeking
records.reason: VideoSeek uses tool-guided temporal search for long-video agents, but the primary text emphasizes task solving and does not establish a net reduction in inference cost after search/tool overhead.

records.title: Evaluating the Dispatchable Capacity of Cross-Regional Data Center Clusters Toward Power System Operation
records.reason: The cited power-systems article concerns dispatchable capacity of cross-regional data-center clusters, but its primary full text was inaccessible; the LLM-serving lineage connection cannot be verified from the title alone.

records.title: Saddle-to-Saddle Dynamics Explains A Simplicity Bias Across Neural Network Architectures
records.reason: The paper studies a simplicity bias in neural-network training dynamics, with no inference-serving efficiency contribution.

records.title: Spike-Driven Lightweight Large Language Model With Evolutionary Computation
records.reason: The IEEE publisher abstract describes a spiking, quantized lightweight language model for edge deployment, but full text was not accessible; implementation and inference measurements therefore could not be checked.
